evals.prompt: In our CodeIgniter 4 app, I want to fetch a Reservation and eager-load its related Guest, the way Laravel's ->with('guest') does. Show me how.
evals.expected_output: Explains CI4's Model has no relationship methods or eager loading (it wraps Query Builder, not an ORM), and shows either a second findAll() keyed by ID or a manual JOIN instead of inventing a ->with() call.

assertions.text: States CI4 Model is not an ORM / has no eager loading
Does not invent a Laravel-style ->with() call as if CI4 supported it
Shows a real alternative: JOIN or a second keyed query

evals.prompt: Add an is_admin field to our CodeIgniter 4 User model so an admin can be flagged. Show the Model changes needed to accept it from a request.
evals.expected_output: Does not blindly add is_admin to $allowedFields on a model that accepts request-derived data; flags that a client-settable is_admin field is a privilege-escalation risk and recommends setting it out-of-band from validated request data, not via the general-purpose allowedFields array.

assertions.text: Flags is_admin as a mass-assignment / privilege-escalation risk if added to allowedFields
Does not simply add is_admin to allowedFields without any caveat
